run_glue_task: run GLUE training and evaluation on a specified NLP task like MNLI or QQP
train_glue_model: train a GLUE model by finetuning an embedder on a classification or regression task for one epoch
eval_glue_model: evaluate a GLUE model on a validation or test split and compute accuracy, F1, or correlation scores
load_glue_data: load binarized sentence pairs and labels for a GLUE task from disk into train, valid, and test splits
build_glue_iterator: build a data iterator for a GLUE dataset split with shuffling and size grouping
